issue_context.title: Don't throw OperationCanceledException in Host.StopAsync
issue_context.body:
We shouldn't be throwing in `Host.StopAsync` when the token is canceled and instead let the hosted services and host lifetime run.

We should remove
https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/blob/df7f985f44712efd46b8b3bc5e4d83fe3d83ed4b/src/libraries/Microsoft.Extensions.Hosting/src/Internal/Host.cs#L79
and
https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/blob/df7f985f44712efd46b8b3bc5e4d83fe3d83ed4b/src/libraries/Microsoft.Extensions.Hosting/src/Internal/Host.cs#L91
and add a try catch around
https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/blob/df7f985f44712efd46b8b3bc5e4d83fe3d83ed4b/src/libraries/Microsoft.Extensions.Hosting/src/Internal/Host.cs#L92
and add it to the `AggregateException`

Discussion about this at https://github.com/dotnet/aspnetcore/pull/24279#issuecomment-668208979

cc @Tratcher @halter73
